description: Set the order the user's camera walks through their scripts — pass ids first-to-record first. Scripts you leave out keep their current order after the ones you name. Use it when the user says what to shoot first, or after planning a batch that should be recorded in sequence.

ids.description: Script ids in the order they should be recorded, first first. Scripts you leave out keep their current order, after the ones you name.

name: reorder_planned_scripts
title: Set the shoot order
